name: Bottle of Disease
summary: Forsaken alchemists brew disease near the Dor'Danil Barrow Den in Ashenvale. The bottles hold virulent concoctions found at their encampment.

sections.title: Blight in the Sacred Woods
sections.body: Near the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, Forsaken alchemists brew contagions in an outpost beyond the Warsong Outriders' front lines. The bottles give night elves at Forest Song evidence of an offensive aimed at sickening the woodland soil and wildlife instead of meeting their sentinels in open combat.

sections.title: Kayneth Stillwind's Investigation
sections.body: Kayneth Stillwind, a night elf sentry at Forest Song, seeks proof of Forsaken ambitions. He wants a Bottle of Disease so he can study its contents. The night elves fear the mixtures could corrupt sacred barrows and break the minds and bodies of the forest's defenders.

faq.q: What is inside the Bottle of Disease?
faq.answer: Forsaken apothecaries brew synthetic poisons and magical contagions in the bottle. The Royal Apothecary Society conducts broader experiments with virulent blights.

aliases: where to find bottle of disease
faq.answer: The bottles are in an isolated Forsaken encampment south of Forest Song, near the entrance to Dor'Danil Barrow Den in eastern Ashenvale.

faq.q: Who wants the Bottle of Disease?
faq.answer: Kayneth Stillwind, a night elf protector at Forest Song, wants you to retrieve a bottle so he can test its contents and learn the Horde's intentions.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken brewing diseases in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The night elves suspect the Forsaken mean to infect the sacred forest and desecrate nearby barrow dens, poisoning the ecosystem and weakening night elven resistance from within.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know that undead contagion on Ashenvale's soil is an unforgivable affront, especially near Dor'Danil Barrow Den.
As a druid, you know blighted mixtures and artificial plagues oppose natural balance. You must act swiftly to preserve the woodland.
